lore: A crafting table that never clears its grid.
use: Keeps its 3x3 grid: closing the screen leaves the items where they are, and they lie flat on the table's top.
secret: A tidy way to keep a recipe set up: the items stay on the table, visible, until you pick them up.

lore: {name}: an open box of planks where the harvest waits for the pot.
use: Stores up to 9 stacks of food in at most 9 different kinds; each kind is a layer, the newest on top, seen through the slats. Craft from 7 planks of one wood in a U. Right-click with food puts the stack in, an empty hand takes the top stack out.
secret: Sneaking with an empty hand takes just one item. Hoppers fill and empty crates, a comparator reads the fill level, and the tag simplestorage:crate_storable lets modpacks allow non-food items.
